text:
jasmin: quick thread on two interlocking things: compact pin encoding (we're hitting metadata size limits) and a safe revocation flow for pins. sketching proposals below.

tess: good call. smaller pins help in headers and traces. what's the target size?

jasmin: target <= 256 bytes for the hot-path token. full provenance lives behind snapshot_id in archive. hot-path token should be opaque and cheap to parse.

alex: proposal: compact token fields: intent (1 char), affinity (2 chars base62), scope shortcode (2-4 chars), snapshot_prefix (4 chars). server expands snapshot_prefix to snapshot_id. keeps control-plane footprint small.

olivia: suggestion: deterministic affinity 0-100 encoded as two base62 chars; default 50 when absent. also include pin_encoding hint in responses so SDKs can handle both.

jasmin: sample compact token idea: "PIN:v1:R:1G:AC:Zx9a" where R=reserve, 1G=affinity, AC=scope code, Zx9a=snapshot prefix. server unpacks to archived manifest.

alex: fallback: always accept full json manifests on client responses for backcompat. add response field pin_encoding: "compact" or "json" so SDKs switch decode path.

tess: revocation flow: current single-step revoke is risky for live sessions. propose two-step: 1) soft revoke (mark revoked=true) -> resolver prefers fallbacks for new resolves but existing sessions allowed for grace window. 2) hard revoke after grace window -> block new attaches and evict per policy.

olivia: add audit events for both transitions and show countdown in console. include actor, reason, and grace_window_seconds in audit entry.

jasmin: operational detail: during soft revoke, server returns an optional small revocation_advice blob: suggested_fallback and timeline. keep it tiny. SDKs may surface to devs but not required.

alex: security: keep provenance encrypted in archive; compact token only carries snapshot_prefix that maps to kms-protected snapshot. human-readable provenance stays in audit UI only.

tess: migration for old pins: if affinity missing, treat as 50 and emit pin_migrated event in archive with migration_timestamp. record migrated:true in snapshot.

olivia: server-side sanity checks: compact token must round-trip encode->decode->encode identical; verify allowed_variants exist at pin creation; reject if zero variants unless force=true with explicit risk ack.

jasmin: tie-breaker for resolver ranking: 1) higher affinity wins; 2) if equal, prefer compatibility score; 3) if equal, prefer lower expected p99; 4) if equal, lower cost. will document in appendix.

ops-bot: revocation-service v1.9 deployed in us-west-2

jasmin: next steps: i'll add compact token spec and revocation state machine to the RFC, migration steps, and telemetry events (pin_migrated, pin_soft_revoke, pin_hard_revoke). will PR later today.

tess: sdk team wants a README showing how to decode compact token and reconcile live sessions.

jasmin: noted. closing after PR and README land.
